title: Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.29218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. translated_title: Ego-HMB：基于运动桥接扩散模型从自视角图像实现人体运动桥接
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“自视角人体运动桥接”这一任务，即从两张端点自视角图像生成连贯的3D人体运动序列。与传统运动补全需要结构化的3D端点姿态不同，该设定使用VR/AR和机器人领域中可穿戴设备所能提供的原始第一人称观测。由于视角变化、人体部分可见性以及跨模态端点约束下的时间模糊性，该任务充满挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Ego-HMB，一个统一的基于扩散模型的框架，通过两个训练阶段在单一模型中同时学习端点姿态估计与时间一致的运动填充。第一阶段“自视角到规范空间预训练”采用逐步增大时间跨度的层级课程，以强化端点姿态先验；第二阶段“运动桥接扩散训练”融合了端点感知与物理感知，从邻……
tldr: 提出Ego-HMB统一扩散框架，仅凭两张第一人称自视角图像即可生成连贯的3D人体运动序列，摆脱了传统方法对结构化3D端点姿态的依赖。
en_tdlr: Ego-HMB is a unified two-stage diffusion framework that bridges coherent 3D human motion directly from two egocentric first-person images, eliminating the need for structured 3D endpoint poses.
